findings.question: indicator C2: Is a national sovereign or government cloud platform in operation (not announced)?

findings.quote_english: The Public Sector Government Cloud (G-Cloud) means the set of digital infrastructures managed by the General Secretariat for Public Administration Information Systems (GSIS)

findings.note: Same Article 87 provision as the lawspot mirror, now on the official Government Gazette server; paragraphs 2-3 also define RE-Cloud (GRNET) and H-Cloud (IDIKA).

review.established: yes
review.reason: Art. 87 of Law 4727/2020 defines G-Cloud, in the present tense, as the digital infrastructure that the General Secretariat for Information Systems of Public Administration (ΓΓΠΣΔΔ) manages. Art. 86 around it requires public bodies to use it. This is a statutory definition, not an operational report, so it is a legal basis for the platform more than proof that it runs today.

findings.question: indicator C2: Is a national sovereign or government cloud platform in operation (not announced)?

review.established: yes

findings.question: indicator K2: Is the national electronic identity scheme operated by the state or a state-controlled body?
